design: 2 framings x 7 items (3 NONE + 4 fallacy controls, one per mechanism) x 2 models x 15 reps = 420 calls
power: McNemar on 90 NONE pairs: 0.97 to detect a rise 0.139->0.40; 1.00 at 0.139->0.50. At 3 reps (18 pairs) power was only 0.49 at 0.50 — insufficient.
primary_test: McNemar on NONE items, framing A vs B, paired within item+model+rep
control_test: fallacy-item accuracy must NOT drop under B; if it does, B traded one bias for another

stopping_rule.H_bias: NONE rate under B >= 0.50 and controls hold -> difficulty is OUR wording; reword stem and re-run the whole sound-arg class
stopping_rule.H_deficit: NONE rate under B < 0.30 and controls hold -> deficit survives; sound-arg graduates with framing effect bounded
stopping_rule.inconclusive: fallacy controls drop under B -> redesign the neutral stem

lint: both framings pass itembank_lint.py with 0 ERROR 0 WARN
